text: FC Baltika (Russian: Акционерное Общество «Футбольный клуб «Балтика») is a professional association football club based in Kaliningrad, Russia. The club was founded on 23 August 1954 as Pishchevik Kaliningrad and was renamed Baltika in 1958. It entered the Soviet League in 1957 and played in Class B (1957–1965), Class A, Group 2 (1966–1970), and the Second League (1971–1991). The best result was achieved in 1984, when Baltika won the regional group tournament. In 1992, Baltika entered the Russian Second Division and won the regional tournament to gain promotion to the First Division. After finishing fourth in 1993 and third in 1994, Baltika won the division in 1995. In 1996, Baltika achieved the best result in club history by finishing 7th in the Top Division, the Russian Premier League. The club was relegated in 1998, spending a total of three seasons in the top flight. In 1998, Baltika participated in the Intertoto Cup and reached the third round. Since then, Baltika played in the First Division, except for the 2002 and 2005 seasons when they were in the Second Division. In the 2018–19 Russian Football National League, they finished 16th (a relegation spot), but PFL zone East winners FC Sakhalin Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk did not apply for the FNL license, keeping Baltika in the league. On 19 May 2023, Baltika secured promotion to the Russian Premier League for the first time in 25 years. In the 2023–24 Russian Cup, Baltika advanced to the Superfinal. Baltika finished 15th in the league season and was relegated back to the second tier after one year in the Premier League. On 2 June 2024, Baltika lost the 2024 Russian Cup final to Zenit St. Petersburg with a score of 1–2; Baltika initially led 1–0 but conceded two goals in the 81st minute and in the 5th added minute. On 10 May 2025, Baltika secured a top-2 finish in the First League season and earned promotion back to the Russian Premier League for the 2025–26 season. As of 10 January 2026, according to the official Russian Premier League website. Baltika's reserve team played professionally in the Russian Third League in 1994 as FC Baltika-d Kaliningrad and in the Russian Second Division in 2006 and 2007 as FC Baltika-2 Kaliningrad.
